founder.name: Daniela Reyes
founder.summary: Ex-Stripe senior PM (5 yrs) with deep SMB payments operator chops; led Stripe Tax SMB launch to ~$30M ARR as de-facto partner-BD / cross-functional closer. Strongest in 0-to-1 phase.

archetype.rationale: Day-to-day work was BD/compliance-unblock/launch-leadership, not spec writing. Active domain-hunting via Substack and M&A tracker. Non-zero but capped technical ability.

evidence: Visa chargeback thresholds cited unprompted: 0.9% VMP, 1.8% VDMP, $25K/month penalty fees
SMB KYC onboarding drop-off ~38% concentrated on ownership-percentage field for co-owned LLCs
Card-present vs CNP interchange reimbursement fee gap of 15-40 bps within same MCC; named hybrid-POS arbitrage
market_edge.notes: Arcana volunteered without prompting. Practitioner-level, not headline-level.

evidence: Led launch team of 7 for Stripe Tax SMB
Closed enterprise referral deals with partner banks
Ran pre-launch pilot across 40 merchants (Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce)
Spoke at Money 20/20 twice; quoted in Stripe 2024 SMB report
gaps: No evidence of external fundraising or founder-level hiring
Intrapreneurial catalyst (Stripe brand, handed-down compliance + partner context) — not yet tested from fully cold start

evidence: Built Retool + SQL dispute-triage internal tool solo in ~3 weeks
limits: Explicitly says she cannot ship a real MVP solo
Needs a technical co-founder or strong first engineer

evidence: 9-month personal Substack on SMB chargeback disputes
insight_edge.notes: Active thesis-formation habit. No publicly named wedge yet.

embedded_finance.note: Academic knowledge only; no warm intros to BaaS / embedded issuing platforms

insider_markers: Co-author of Stripe's internal chargeback-ops playbook

motivations.composite_notes: Not averaged. Scored independently — she's clear-eyed that she's not a lifer on any single problem (missionary moderate) but has a named exit band and timeframe (mercenary moderate-high).

items.signal: Personal Substack on SMB chargeback disputes
Spreadsheet of every SMB fintech M&A deal since 2022

evidence: Self-reports loving pre-launch pilot chaos (40-merchant pilot across 3 platforms)
Self-reports hating the post-$30M-ARR funnel-optimization phase

weakness.note: Will likely want to hand off ops by Series A/B; surface to co-founder early

legal.impact: Limits fastest-path GTM to ex-Stripe merchants; forces inbound/content, partner-channel, non-Stripe SMBs, or wait-out

minor_notes: Catalyst Edge is intrapreneurial (Stripe brand + handed-down compliance/partner context). Probe handling of fully-cold-start ambiguity — no brand, no compliance team, no warm partner intros.
Psychographic commitment is conditional ('if the problem is right'). Not yet locked on a specific wedge — factor into co-founder / investor conversations.
Technical Edge claim is well-calibrated — founder flags her own ceiling. Treat as honest self-assessment, not a flag.

best_fit_problem_shapes: SMB payments / fintech with compliance or partner-bank heavy wedges
Fragmented SMB long-tail products (Shopify/Amazon/Woo pilot pattern)
Chargeback, dispute, KYC, or interchange-optimization products leveraging arcana moat
GTM paths that reach first customers via Stripe alumni / Money 20/20 / #payments Slack — avoiding Stripe merchant list for 18 months
anti_patterns: Pure embedded finance / BaaS where network is cold
Mission-driven long-horizon categories (climate, biotech) incompatible with 5-7yr / $200M-1B frame
Scale-stage optimization roles she explicitly dislikes

recommended_co_founder_profile.nice_to_have: Scale-stage operator willing to own 1-to-N once PMF lands
recommended_co_founder_profile.rationale: Daniela fills BD, compliance, GTM, domain, and 0-to-1 catalyst. Missing: shipping-grade technical leadership and eventual scale-ops appetite.
